services.name: Powerboat Charters - Custom Sightseeing, Watersports, & Cruises - 28 foot. Boats
services.desc: Let your knowledgeable captain be your personal guide around famous Lake Tahoe! Duration 2-6 Hours About Come aboard our large powerboat for a private tour of Lake Tahoe for up to 6 passengers as a regular charter or up to12 as a Bareboat Charter. Have more passengers or want more space? Book multiple boats. Guests can enjoy sightseeing, water sports, swimming, and lounging with friends and family on the boat while they hear amazing tales and history of Lake Tahoe told by your captain. Our tours are unique because of our incredible local and passionate Captains and all the activities that we can incorporate into your tour. services.name: Party Boat - "Vivid Dreams" - 40 ft. w/Captain & Crew
services.desc: Charter the “Vivid Dreams” to cruise breathtaking Lake Tahoe. Duration 2-5 Hours About Enjoy the entire boat for just your private party. With a passenger capacity of up to 35 people, these tours are customized to fit your group’s needs, allowing you to explore historic sites, swim in crystal blue water, watch the sunset, or just enjoy a relaxing time with your family and friends. Build your custom party boat charter today. The Vivid Dreams is perfect for Bachlorette parties, family reunions, work outings, team building, small weddings, Bachelor Parties, Birthdays, or any group outing. You are welcome to bring your own food and beverages on board utilizing our coolers at no additional cost.
